findings.detail: The SIGALRM deadline is armed only after approval, authorization, dependency verification, and reservation, and is disabled at the start of finally. Project-router close, finish_operation, result persistence, and canonical-store close therefore have no enforced deadline. elapsed_seconds is sampled before finish_operation and excludes its duration. A slow or stuck cleanup/finalization can exceed the reviewed 120 seconds and the persisted elapsed charge can understate actual time, so this is not a hard whole-operation bound or complete elapsed accounting.
findings.required_fix: Apply one absolute monotonic deadline across setup and cleanup/finalization; retain bounded cleanup time within the same 120-second ceiling, record the final measured elapsed duration, and leave the operation/result failed or accounting-unknown if settlement cannot be confirmed. Do not report successful setup or settled accounting after an exceeded deadline.

reviewed_behavior.evidence: Producer document() constructs CodexDynamicTools task-service wrappers and reads each definition()['tools']; no service call/handler is invoked. Setup imports the producer, creates the fresh local project, and writes declarations only; it starts no task/model/worker trial.
reviewed_behavior.source_and_path_pins: The runner checks the exact source and producer hashes, canonical manifest hash/database inode, fresh project path, and disk reserve before execution.
reviewed_behavior.replay_guard: The runner uses exclusive creation of a started marker and repository reservation uses a unique operation id; preserve marker and any partial project after an uncertain attempt.

review_scope: Read-only static review. No runner execution, imports, worker/model/auth access, Docker use, grant reservation, canonical-store mutation, or cleanup was performed by this review.
